title: Emergence Savior
summary: Emergence Savior is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that prevents the Operator from taking lethal damage, granting 5 seconds of invulnerability while regenerating health, with a 90 second cooldown.
extract:
Emergence Savior is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that prevents the Operator from taking lethal damage, granting 5 seconds of invulnerability while regenerating health, with a 90 second cooldown.

Effect

Acquisition
Emergence Savior can be purchased from Cavalero for  5,000, requiring Rank 1 - Fallen with The Holdfasts. It can also be dropped by Thrax Centurion, Thrax Legatus, and Void Angels on the Zariman Ten Zero.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Farming Tips
Thrax enemies are abundant in Mobile Defense and Void Cascade missions.
The Zariman Arcane drop is considered as a mod drop, and is thus affected by The Steel Path and Mod Drop Chance Booster.
